sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: One row, one figure: how many distinct people stand on Contoso's customer register — 104,990, each counted exactly once (104,990 rows over 104,990 distinct keys, no null key, so counting distinct and counting rows agree here). What this figure does NOT include, and does not do: it is not a count of buyers — 52,801 of these 104,990 people never appear on a single sales line, so a reader who meant "customers who have bought from us" should be handed 52,189 instead. It applies no period filter, so it is not "customers this year"; the register carries its own valid_from/valid_to history and I filtered on neither. It applies no place, gender or status filter, and it joins no store — so the online/physical channel split and the `--` country sentinel never arise, and no customer carries that sentinel in any case.
